answer: Count independent paths, then square the length. A claim backed by 3 disjoint paths of length 4 scores 12; the same 3 paths sharing a tundra of intermediate nodes score 4. Oasis pricing follows the score, so a farm of 300 clones sharing 2 hops earns a third of a spread of 30. An orchard of honest agents across 12 providers keeps full weight at 1 path each. The smallest fake needs 3 disjoint routes and a 30-day wait, more than one honest task.
